sourceFiles.scope: vault allocator, lock state, compaction, telemetry ring, arena growth

methods.name: GlobalDataVault.TryAcquireWriteLock<T>
methods.currentFenceGate: none at first line; downstream TryResolveHandle rejects active compaction after metadata mutation is possible
methods.raceWindow: active writer id can become non-zero before VaultArenaBlock.Reserved0/Reserved1 lock is written; compactor can observe no block lock if fence activates between these operations
methods.requiredFix: Volatile.Read(_compactionFence) first-line after out default; Thread.MemoryBarrier around ActiveWriterSystemID acquire; set block pin under compaction recheck; publish metadata after block lock and release barrier

methods.name: GlobalDataVault.ReleaseWriteLock<T>
methods.currentAtomicRoute: reads ActiveWriterSystemID naked, then Interlocked.CompareExchange to zero after block release
methods.raceWindow: release can reorder block unlock and writer clear on weak ARM64 ordering unless explicit barriers are used
methods.requiredFix: Volatile.Read active writer; release barrier before writer clear; final barrier after metadata write

methods.name: GlobalDataVault.TryLockBuffer
methods.currentAtomicRoute: increments VaultArenaBlock.Reserved1 then sets active lock bit after metadata check
methods.raceWindow: compactor/growth can observe ActiveBurstLockMask zero before SetActiveLockBit while block lock mutation is in progress
methods.requiredFix: Volatile.Read(_compactionFence) first-line; reserve active lock bit before block mutation; recheck compaction fence after bit acquire; release bit on every failure

methods.name: GlobalDataVault.TryUnlockBuffer
methods.currentAtomicRoute: decrements Reserved1 then clears active bit if no block maps to that bit
methods.raceWindow: unlock ordering can expose zero active mask before block write is visible unless release barrier is explicit
methods.requiredFix: barrier before active bit clear; use volatile/fenced block release helper

methods.name: GlobalDataVault.TryRunLiveCompactionSlice
methods.currentFenceGate: Volatile.Read(_compactionFence) before Interlocked.Exchange; loop checks HasActiveBurstLocks(activeBurstLockMask)
methods.currentAtomicRoute: Interlocked.Exchange sets fence; loop checks ActiveBurstLockMask and block Reserved0/Reserved1 before MemMove
methods.raceWindow: uses caller-supplied external mask plus local mask; if TryLockBuffer publishes block lock before active bit or TryAcquireWriteLock publishes writer before block lock, compactor can still race
methods.requiredFix: keep compactor fail-closed checks; add telemetry for skipped locked blocks; rely on fixed lock publication ordering

methods.name: GlobalDataVault.TryMoveOccupiedBlockLeft
methods.currentFenceGate: called only from TryRunLiveCompactionSlice after fence acquisition
methods.currentAtomicRoute: checks BlockFlagLocked, BlockFlagExternalView, Reserved1 before UnsafeUtility.MemMove
methods.raceWindow: safe only if all lock paths publish block/active bits before compactor enters
methods.requiredFix: recheck active masks immediately before MemMove and count skip telemetry

methods.name: GlobalDataVault.TryGrowArenaForBytes
methods.currentFenceGate: checks _compactionFence and _allocationLock, but does not read ActiveBurstLockMask
methods.raceWindow: H8Memory.ReallocateRaw can relocate/free the arena while a scheduled job owns a raw alias if _activeLocks != 0
methods.requiredFix: Volatile.Read(_compactionFence) and ActiveBurstLockMask fail-closed before desired-size math and immediately before TryGrowArena

methods.name: GlobalDataVault.TryGrowArena
methods.currentFenceGate: checks stress only; called by TryGrowArenaForBytes
methods.raceWindow: must not be reachable under active locks; caller gate is currently insufficient
methods.requiredFix: secondary active-lock and compaction-fence guard inside TryGrowArena before ReallocateRaw

methods.name: GlobalDataVault.RecordDefragBlackBox
methods.currentAtomicRoute: writes NativeArray element by value; cursor/count are naked int writes
methods.raceWindow: single owner phase assumed; explicit pointer write and volatile cursor publication required by task
methods.requiredFix: write through NativeArrayUnsafeUtility pointer and use Volatile.Write/Interlocked bounded cursor update

methods.name: GlobalDataVault.WriteDefragBlackBoxFile
methods.currentAtomicRoute: writes headers through BinaryWriter and entries through ReadOnlySpan<byte>
methods.raceWindow: not hot path but allocates managed FileStream/BinaryWriter on dump call; task asks for background route to 1310 dump file
methods.requiredFix: add 1310 dump path, avoid BinaryWriter for new dump route, copy native ring bytes through FileStream.Write(ReadOnlySpan<byte>) on background thread trigger

methods.name: H8Memory.ReallocateRaw
methods.currentFenceGate: none; lower-level raw allocator trusts caller
methods.currentAtomicRoute: ValidateTrackedPointerOwner, TryReserveReplacementBytes, UnsafeUtility.Malloc, MemMove, RegisterPointer, UnregisterPointer, Free
methods.raceWindow: caller must guarantee no active aliases because old pointer is freed
methods.requiredFix: keep H8Memory generic; enforce DataVault active-lock gate at caller

metadataStructs.name: VaultBufferMeta
metadataStructs.audit: 64-byte cache-line DTO; ActiveWriterSystemID shares cache line with version/type/ref flags

metadataStructs.name: VaultArenaBlock
metadataStructs.audit: 32-byte block record; two records per 64-byte cache line, so adjacent block mutation can false-share but struct size matches prompt

metadataStructs.name: MemoryDefragTelemetryEntry
metadataStructs.audit: 128-byte telemetry record, two 64-byte cache lines, multiple-of-8 and ARM64 safe; offset 76 now records locked/active-mask compaction skips

phaseRecord.phase: PRE_SIMULATION for relocation/growth admission; POST_SIMULATION for blackbox ring publication
phaseRecord.loadShedFallback: fail closed: skip compaction/growth/lock acquisition, record alias-blocked/fault telemetry
